wider_means: A wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet: the carcass grows and a second joystick and button cluster are added beside the first.
taller_means: A taller arcade cabinet is simply a taller carcass: longer plain side and front panels above the marquee, in the panel between the control deck and the coin door, and in the kick area below the coin door — the marquee, screen and controls stay one of a kind.
